relationships.subject: tofacitinib
relationships.evidence_quote: Moreover, significant decreases in the expression of collagen I, Ki67, p-STAT 3, and p-SMAD2 were observed after 12 weeks of administration.

relationships.subject: tofacitinib
relationships.evidence_quote: In vitro experiments suggested that tofacitinib treatment inhibits fibroblast proliferation and collagen I synthesis via suppression of STAT3 and SMAD2 pathway.

key_findings: Oral tofacitinib improved scar scores and reduced keloid volume in 7 patients, with decreased p-STAT3 and p-SMAD2.
